title: runs/<run-id>/artifacts/data/contingency.yaml
description: The contingency plan record (S-4): the policy it rests on, the business impact analysis, the recovery strategy, sites, backup, teams, procedures, exercises and maintenance. CPLAN-001 to CPLAN-003 judge it.

policy.title: Contingency planning policy this plan rests on

statement.title: Contingency planning policy statement, with its objectives, framework and responsibilities

senior_management.title: Senior management support for the contingency program and policy

impact_levels.title: FIPS 199 impact levels and contingency controls the policy reflects

activation_criteria.title: Activation criteria for outages or disruptions the policy states

backup.title: Backup policy: minimum frequency, scope, location, naming, rotation and transport

scope.title: Backup scope, incremental, differential or full

storage.title: Location, file naming, media rotation and offsite transport of backed-up data

scope.title: Plan identity and how it fits the suite of plans

plan_type.title: Plan type, an information system contingency plan

related_plans.title: Related plans coordinated with this one, each with its version, location and point of contact

processes.title: Mission or business processes with maximum tolerable downtime, recovery time and recovery point objectives, reprocessing time and priority

resources.title: Resources needed for recovery with their interdependencies

impact_categories.title: Impact categories and the severity scale of each

objectives.title: Impacts analyzed against availability, integrity, confidentiality and the FIPS 199 level

availability.title: Impact on availability, the basis of the BIA

pocs.title: Internal and external points of contact consulted, including data partners and interconnected systems

cost_balance.title: Optimum recovery point balancing the cost of inoperability against the cost of recovery

associated_priorities.title: Impacts and priorities of associated systems, LANs, WANs and telecommunications the BIA gives

continuity_input.title: Telecommunications and FCD-2 continuity inputs to the system BIA

power.title: Power protection: UPS, generator and fuel

standardization.title: Standardized hardware, software and peripherals and off-the-shelf compatibility

telecommunications_diagrams.title: Physical and logical telecommunications diagrams kept up to date

single_points_of_failure.title: Single points of failure and the redundant cables, routers and devices that answer them

remote_access.title: Remote access as a contingency capability, with bandwidth and security controls

wan.title: WAN contingency solutions, communications links and provider redundancy

design.title: Technical measures designed in: redundancy, robustness, power and data mirroring

failover.title: Failover mode and redundancy of critical components

strategy.title: Recovery strategy and why it fits the system

fit.title: How the methods and strategies answer the disruption impacts and allowable downtimes of the BIA

availability_fit.title: How the strategy matches the FIPS 199 availability impact level and system life cycle

risk_basis.title: Risk-informed decisions behind the resilience methods

alternatives.title: Alternative strategies compared on cost, downtime, security and priority

high_availability.title: High availability: whether it is used, why the system warrants it, and its extension to an alternate location

equipment.title: Equipment needs: model or version, specifications, quantity and replacement approach

budget.title: Cost of each option weighed against the budget, with the cost-benefit analysis

data_protection.title: Encryption of stored and backup data and the key management that keeps it readable

rto_gaps.title: Plan of Action and Milestone item for each process whose RTO cannot be met, or is not yet proven

unproven.title: true: the RTO is estimated but no exercise has shown it yet; until A-6 writes the POA&M the gap names the exercise that will prove it, from A-6 a POA&M item

exercise.title: The exercise of this plan that will prove the RTO

dynamic_allocation.title: How information resources are allocated dynamically to sustain mission operations

sites.title: Offsite storage, alternate site and the agreements behind them

offsite_store.title: Offsite storage facility and the criteria it was chosen on

selection.title: Offsite storage facility selection against geography, accessibility, security, environment and cost

security.title: Security capabilities of the shipping method, storage facility and personnel

alternate_site.title: Alternate site, its type and why it fits

selection.title: Alternate site choice against core requirements, the BIA, downtime and FIPS 199 level

location.title: Geographic hazard, transport time and mode to the site

control_compatibility.title: Security, management, operational and technical controls compatible with the prospective site

agreements.title: Contract, reciprocal agreement, MOU or SLA behind each site

vendor_agreements.title: Vendor SLAs: response time and priority for replacement equipment

solution.title: Backup solution chosen on device compatibility, storage volume, software and medium

system_software.title: System software, drivers, licenses and image loads stored at an alternate location

client_data.title: Critical user data on central servers, automated client backup and guidance on saving data

stand_alone.title: Backup of stand-alone systems and the storage of their media at an alternate site

multi_server.title: Centralized storage and a dedicated backup network in a multi-server environment

activation_authority.title: The one designated authority that activates the plan, and the successor

role.title: Designated authority that activates the plan

director.title: ISCP Director with overall management responsibility

coordinator.title: ISCP Coordinator overseeing recovery and reconstitution

owner_poc.title: System owner or business unit point of contact

teams.title: Recovery teams, staffed by skill, each with a leader and an alternate

vendors.title: Vendors and providers with contacts, contract numbers, response times and service agreements

with_notice.title: Notification procedures with prior notice of an outage

without_notice.title: Notification procedures with no notice, in and out of business hours

method.title: Who starts notification, the sequence and the method, and its limits such as email

unreachable.title: What is done when a person cannot be contacted, with primary and alternate contact methods

external_pocs.title: External organizations and interconnected system partners notified, each with a POC

content.title: Type of information relayed to those notified

areas.title: Minimum areas: cause, potential for further damage, affected area, infrastructure, equipment, items to replace, time to restore

follow_up.title: How the assessment result updates notification and the planned response

format.title: Stepwise, sequential, checklist procedures that assume no step

tailoring.title: How the plan balances detail with flexibility for this system

sequence.title: Recovery sequence tied to BIA priorities and the MTD

actions_by_team.title: Procedures assigned to each recovery team

escalation.title: Events, thresholds and triggers that escalate, and the notices that follow

shipment.title: Shipment of backup media, hardware, plans and software to an alternate site

supporting_systems.title: Contact and procedures of a system this one relies on for recovery

alternate_processing.title: Alternate manual or technical processing procedures

activation_summary.title: Who may activate the plan and the recovery activities this strategy sets

test_plan.title: System validation test plan run before the system returns to users

cleanup.title: Cleanup of temporary recovery locations, supplies, manuals and media

offsite_return.title: Return of retrieved media to offsite data storage

return_to_normal.title: Declaration of return to normal, and the significant change determination with the concurrence of the Authorizing Official

event_documentation.title: Recovery events documented with actions, problems and lessons learned

covers.title: What training covers: roles, skills and plan elements

new_personnel.title: Training of personnel newly appointed to ISCP roles

backup_media.title: Regular testing of backup media, at the alternate site where applicable

readiness.title: First TT&E event in Implementation/Assessment and how the plan stays ready

triggers.title: What triggers a TT&E event: period, organizational or system change, new guidance

improvement.title: How results update and improve the plan

exercises.title: Exercises and tests, each with objectives, success criteria, scope, scenario and logistics

held_on.title: The date the exercise was held; one not yet held proves no dynamic allocation (CPLAN-003)

review.title: Review frequency, significant change triggers and the minimum review elements

copies.title: Marking and distribution of the plan, record of copies, a copy at the alternate site and vital records stored with it

record_of_changes.title: Record of changes in the plan, with page number, change comment and date

coordination.title: Coordination on change with internal and external points of contact, and version control

change_response.title: BIA updated on a significant change, and upkeep through disposal

approval.title: Signed approval affirming the plan is complete and tested, and who keeps it maintained

personnel_contacts.title: Personnel contact list with an office and a non-office number

diagrams.title: System, input and output diagrams or the SSP section they come from

inventory.title: Hardware and software inventory the plan restores

interconnections.title: Interconnections table: type of connection, information transferred and contact person

plan_approval.title: The plan's approval: who approved which version and when; a completed POA&M milestone that approves the plan finds it here (MPOA-001)

control_id.description: OSCAL control id from the catalog (ac-2, ac-2.1).

source.description: Trace token: an interview answer (INT-007.A3), an assumption (ASM-012, ASM-BASELINE-001), a product file with optional anchor (product/architecture.md#identity) or an artifact (ART-SSP).
